description: This file is a Kotlin source code defining a Jetpack Compose UI screen called ConnectTabScreen, which manages user interface for connecting and configuring gateway connections in an Android app. It includes composable functions for UI components, state management, and interaction logic related to gateway setup, status display, and advanced controls.

classes.name: ConnectInputMode
classes.description: An enum class representing the current input mode for the connection setup, either 'SetupCode' or 'Manual'.

methods.name: ConnectTabScreen
methods.description: A Composable function that renders the UI for the connection setup and status management screen, handling user inputs, connection states, and interactions.

methods.name: MethodChip
methods.description: A composable button representing a selectable connection method option.

methods.name: QuickFillChip
methods.description: A composable button for quick-filling predefined host and port configurations.

methods.name: CommandBlock
methods.description: A composable for displaying a command string in a styled block.

methods.name: EndpointPreview
methods.description: Displays the resolved gateway endpoint in the UI.

methods.name: outlinedColors
methods.description: Defines the color scheme for outlined text fields.
